title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.


Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction


What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE


Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

title: Hunter B2B de Publicidade
description:
Sobre a Orla Rio

Somos a maior plataforma de experiências ao ar livre do Brasil.

Aqui, ativamos marcas com o pé na areia e o coração no lifestyle .

Nosso negócio é conectar grandes ideias a momentos inesquecíveis — do nascer ao pôr do sol.

Sua missão será abrir caminhos.

O Hunter será responsável por desbravar novos mercados , identificar oportunidades, construir relacionamentos estratégicos e posicionar a Orla Rio como a plataforma de mídia mais desejada do país para marcas que querem se conectar com o público de forma autêntica, criativa e memorável.

  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais iniciais e propor soluções personalizadas com olhar consultivo .
  • Alimentar e gerenciar o CRM com disciplina, inteligência e visão de pipeline.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os hubs de publicidade e com a área de growth para sinergia nas entregas.

Perfil ideal:

  • Hunter nato: tem brilho no olho por abrir negócios, sabe onde cutucar e não tem medo de porta fechada.

  • Repertório criativo: acompanha campanhas, entende timing cultural, vive o mercado publicitário.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior em vendas B2B — preferencialmente em publicidade, mídia OOH, ativações ou brand experience.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências e das dinâmicas de marketing e trade marketing das grandes marcas.
  • Vivência em funções como SDR, pré-vendas, inside sales ou hunter.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Organização, foco, resiliência e autogestão.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM como RD Station , Ramper ou similares.
  • Capacidade de pensar como estrategista, agir como vendedor(a) e se portar como parceiro de negócios.


Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado com projetos especiais, experiências de marca ou ativações em campo.
  • Conhecimento da cultura carioca, comportamento de consumo de praia e lifestyle local.
  • Portfólio de clientes relevantes ou histórico de contas de impacto.
  • Inglês fluente: leitura, escrita e conversação.


Remuneração:

Modalidade PJ - Remuneração a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial) + comissão.


Se você acredita que o melhor da vida acontece ao ar livre , sabe como contar boas histórias com marcas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está redesenhando o jeito de viver (e anunciar) no Rio , esse é o seu lugar.

title: Sales Development Representative (LATAM)
description:
The successful candidate will be a Portuguese and English speaker, based remotely in the LATAM region (preferably Brazil), to enable collaboration with the wider team and assist in their knowledge and skills development.


Our Sales Development team is the vanguard of our business, with Sales Development Reps (SDRs) driving interest in Absolute and initiating the sales cycle. In this role, you will collaborate with our Marketing and Account Executive teams to research and build a pipeline in new and existing accounts. You will follow up on both inbound and outbound leads predominately across Brazil and wider LATAM regions, engaging with prospects. Your exceptional communication and critical thinking skills will enable you to quickly assess opportunities and secure meetings with key account personas for our Account Executives. You’ll drive revenue growth from new account acquisitions and foster expansion and cross-sell opportunities with existing customers.


Responsibilities:

  • Generate and qualify leads, identifying prospects genuinely interested in our cybersecurity solutions
  • Prioritize and research prospects, understanding their current IT situation, challenges, and needs
  • Engage prospective clients via phone, email, and social media (LinkedIn) to convey Absolute’s unique value propositions
  • Schedule qualified meetings for Sales through cold calling and strategic outreach, converting them into pipeline opportunities
  • Build and prioritize strategic account lists within a defined segment
  • Foster alignment and positive partnerships with internal Field Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participate in virtual and/or in-person events as needed
  • Utilize our CRM system (Salesforce) to log activity and lead conversion data for business transparency
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers


Requirements:

  • Portuguese language and English proficiency essential. Additional language capabilities, especially Spanish is desirable
  • Resilience and a fearless approach to challenges, particularly in objection handling
  • Strong communication skills for effective interaction with customers, prospects, and team members
  • Ambitious individuals eager to learn and contribute significantly to the business's continued success
  • Previous sales experience (1-3 years preferred) with a proven track record of consistently opening qualified opportunities that lead to revenue
  • Experience in B2B lead generation, ideally within the cybersecurity space, is a bonus but not essential



Why Work For Us:


You’re resilient and passionate about securing the Work from Anywhere era. So are we.


We’re in search of the best and the brightest – everyone from innovators, sellers and marketers to financers, operators and especially customer relationship managers – we’re looking for top tier talent to help us shape the next decade of security, drive innovation that enables customers with truly disruptive solutions and are dedicated to making a meaningful difference.


Headquartered in Seattle, Washington with international offices in Vancouver - BC, Austin - TX, Boulder - CO, Ankeny – IA, Reading - UK and Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam, Absolute Security accelerates customers’ shift to work-from-anywhere through the industry’s first self-healing Zero Trust platform, ensuring maximum security and uncompromised productivity. Only Absolute is embedded in more than half a billion devices, offering a permanent digital connection that intelligently and dynamically applies visibility, control and self-healing capabilities to endpoints, applications, and network access to ensure their cyber resilience tailored for distributed workforces.


Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Absolute currently serves approximately 16,000 customers with more than 13 million activated endpoints globally. G2 recognized Absolute as a Leader in the Winter 2022 Endpoint Management and Zero Trust Networking Grid Reports, reflecting our continued customer satisfaction across product lines. To learn more about Absolute, visit our website at or visit our YouTube channel

title: Especialista de Automação, Controle e Sensoriamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar padrões técnicos para automação e sensoriamento, garantindo uniformidade e eficiência nos processos.
  • Revisar e aprovar projetos de automação das unidades operacionais, assegurando conformidade com diretrizes técnicas.
  • Programar e desenvolver lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, incluindo a criação e revisão de diagramas elétricos.
  • Prestar suporte técnico e consultoria às unidades operacionais, auxiliando na implementação de soluções avançadas de automação.
  • Especificar sensores e instrumentos, garantindo a correta seleção e aplicação nos projetos.
  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para equipes operacionais, promovendo a padronização e disseminação de boas práticas.


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência sólida com CLPs Siemens e/ou Schneider, incluindo programação e lógica de controle.
  • Conhecimento em redes de comunicação industrial e interpretação de diagramas elétricos.
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos de automação.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Gerente Regional de Vendas Jr
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global em produtos de cuidados visuais de classe mundial, incluindo óculos icônicos, tecnologia de lentes avançada e soluções digitais de ponta. Nosso trabalho vai além do nosso negócio. Estamos abrindo novas fronteiras, promovendo a inclusão e a colaboração, abraçando a agilidade, acendendo a paixão e fazendo um impacto positivo no mundo.


Somos o grupo das marcas de cuidados visuais e óculos mais amadas e reconhecidas do mundo. Nosso portfólio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem a marca Essilor, com Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. Nossa rede de venda direta ao consumidor conta com aproximadamente 18.000 lojas que oferecem aos consumidores cuidados visuais de alta qualidade e experiências de compra de classe mundial com uma abordagem verdadeiramente omnicanal através de nossas bandeiras de varejo mundialmente renomadas, como Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò e a rede GrandVision.


Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua própria aventura profissional. Dê um passo para dentro da EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu #FutureInSight?


Se interessou? Veja a descrição da atividade:

Responsável por liderar a estratégia de geração de demanda por meio da integração entre a visitação médica e o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos. Tem o papel de atuar como elo entre o time de campo, médicos, óticas e áreas internas, com foco em fortalecer a recomendação dos produtos EssilorLuxottica, desenvolver o negócio e impulsionar o sell-out no varejo, além de fazer a gestão do time de consultores.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de visitação médica com foco na recomendação e prescrição dos produtos, por meio de visitas regulares a oftalmologistas, utilizando materiais científicos e ferramentas de apoio à visita, como o C4C.
  • Estabelecer e fortalecer o relacionamento com líderes de opinião e sociedades médicas, participando de eventos, congressos e reuniões estratégicas, promovendo a marca e ampliando a influência da empresa no ecossistema médico.
  • Atuar em parceria com o time comercial das óticas e de marketing, garantindo o alinhamento entre as ações de campo e as campanhas, contribuindo diretamente para o aumento do sell-out nas óticas.
  • Liderar iniciativas de capacitação científica e técnica, promovendo treinamentos para médicos e equipes de vendas das óticas, com foco em conhecimento técnico, diferenciais dos produtos e alinhamento com as estratégias da companhia.
  • Atuar como co-responsável pelo desempenho financeiro da regional, acompanhando indicadores como faturamento, margem e P&L (Profit & Loss), contribuindo com análises e decisões estratégicas para garantir a sustentabilidade e rentabilidade do negócio.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) relacionados à geração de demanda, utilizando ferramentas como BI e dashboards internos para análise de dados, identificação de oportunidades e definição de planos de ação personalizados por região ou cliente.
  • Planejar e executar o roteiro de visitas com base em critérios estratégicos de cobertura, frequência e potencial de prescrição, garantindo eficiência e impacto nas ações de campo.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com laboratórios, áreas internas e parceiros, promovendo uma atuação integrada que maximize os resultados da região sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos da Vaga:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas como Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida com visitação médica e gestão de demanda.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de geração de demanda e relacionamento com stakeholders médicos e donos das óticas.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (nível intermediário/avançado), ferramentas de BI e CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo.
  • CNH B ativa.



*A Essilorluxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCDs.

title: Supervisor de Poços
description:
Buscamos um Supervisor de Poços Offshore para atuar como Fiscal de Sonda em operações no ambiente offshore.

O profissional será responsável por supervisionar intervenções em poços, garantindo a execução segura e eficiente das atividades, com foco em operações “rigless” e intervenções complexas em plataformas fixas.



Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar operações de intervenção em poços offshore, garantindo a conformidade com os procedimentos de segurança e controle de poço.
  • Atuar como responsável técnico e fiscal de sonda durante as atividades, assegurando a execução correta das operações.
  • Coordenar atividades “rigless”, incluindo wireline/slickline via tubing, heavy workover e instalação de ESP (bombas de fundo).
  • Realizar verificações de integridade de poços, reparos em árvores de natal (Xmas tree) e gerenciamento de colocação/remoção de plugs.
  • Garantir o uso adequado de equipamentos de controle de pressão e monitorar procedimentos críticos de controle de poço.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para assegurar a entrega dentro dos prazos e padrões exigidos.



Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.
  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de intervenções em poços offshore.
  • Sólida vivência em operações “rigless” e intervenções com e sem sonda.
  • Experiência como operador no Brasil ou internacionalmente (altamente desejável).
  • Conhecimento técnico em operações de sonda em plataformas fixas offshore (diferencial).
  • Proficiência em wireline/slickline via tubing, heavy workover e instalação de ESP.
  • Expertise em verificação de integridade de poços e manuseio de árvores de natal (Xmas tree).
  • Domínio em equipamentos e procedimentos de controle de pressão e poço.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente é essencial.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
QA/QC Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.
  • Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.
  • Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.
  • Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.
  • Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.
  • Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.
  • Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.
  • Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.
  • Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.
  • Familiarity with MEP works is advantageous.
  • Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

title: Senior Operations Manager (Sao Paulo, Brazil)
description:
Senior Operations Manager (Sao Paulo, Brazil)

Experience: 5+ years

Salary Range: BRL 10,000 – 25,000/month

!!! This position requires successful candidates to relocate to São Paulo and begin working on-site.

Company Description

Trade W is a leading multi-asset trading platform with over seven years of industry experience, dedicated in providing global users with secure, convenient, and efficient trading solutions. As of now, over 5 million active users have easily accessed a wide range of CFD trading services, including forex, cryptocurrency, stocks, indices, metals, and commodities, via the Trade W app and website.

Role Description

As an Senior Operations Manager, your primary focus will be on supporting the operational strategies that drive customer conversion, retention, and revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for overseeing and improving performance data within the region, working cross-functionally with various teams to identify opportunities and implement data-driven solutions that enhance the user journey from registration to active trading.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of regional performance data, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and providing actionable insights to support business decisions.
  • Monitor and analyze metrics across the customer lifecycle – from registration to trading – to identify gaps, trends, and areas for improvement.
  • Suggest regional optimization strategies based on user behavior.
  • Developing and executing retention initiatives, such as targeted communications, onboarding flows, or loyalty programs tailored to the region.
  • Support the setup, testing, and reporting of promotions, pop-ups, and in-app messaging aimed at increasing deposits and trading volume.
  • Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure platform and tools are optimized for the region's customer experience and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate reports and dashboards to track key KPIs including conversion rates, churn, ARPU, and regional revenue performance.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to stay informed about regional trends and best practices.

Qualifications

  • Languages: Chinese (listening & speaking) + Portuguese (listening, speaking & writing) + English (listening, speaking & writing)
  • Extensive marketing and operations experience in the Brazilian market ; familiarity with local culture
  • At least 5 years experience in an operational, data, or roles related to market expansion (preferably in fintech, online trading, or financial services).
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in tools like Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with data dashboards or BI tools is a plus.
  • Education Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above
  • Some team management experience, organizational and communication skills with a strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, curious mindset with a passion for optimization and growth.
  • Willingness to travel (a plus)

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of Project Manager , you’ll take ownership of high-value digital infrastructure projects from initiation to handover. ALEC Data Centre Solutions combines speed, security, and technical precision and you’ll be leading teams that deliver mission-critical environments trusted by global tech leaders.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

About Your Team

This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.

Your Role

As a Project Manager , you will:

  • Lead the overall planning, coordination, and execution of data centre construction projects, ensuring alignment with budget, quality, and schedule targets.
  • Manage internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project milestones are achieved.
  • Develop detailed execution strategies and monitor risk, procurement, and resource plans.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations.
  • Oversee reporting, performance tracking, and contractual obligations.
  • Coordinate technical reviews, design validations, and issue resolution.
  • Manage change controls and support commercial teams in claims and EOT matters.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 10+ years of project management experience, preferably in complex construction or mission-critical environments (e.g., data centres, hospitals, infrastructure).
  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of construction lifecycles, contract management, planning tools, and client engagement.
  • Expertise: Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, control budgets, and manage fast-track delivery.
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong leadership, communication, and reporting skills.
  • Degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
  • PMP certification is an advantage.
  • Resilient, hands-on, and capable of leading under pressure.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

Contract wise:

In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

title: Programming Scheduler
description:

About Nosso SportyNet:

SportyNet, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.

Role Overview:

As a Programming Scheduler at SportyNet, you will be responsible for organizing and updating the daily programming schedule in the playout system, ensuring accuracy and alignment with the company’s editorial and operational strategies. This role requires attention to detail, the ability to adapt quickly to live changes, and close coordination with technical and content teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Organize, input, and update the daily programming schedule in the playout system (Media+ or similar), ensuring all broadcast information is accurate and complete;
  • Make real-time operational adjustments to the schedule due to content changes, live events, or editorial strategy updates;
  • Monitor the schedule in real time, identifying inconsistencies or technical conflicts and proposing solutions in collaboration with the coordination team;
  • Collect and organize audience data from both linear and digital platforms to support content performance analysis;
  • Assist in verifying and validating the schedule with MCR and technical teams to ensure operational alignment;
  • Manage the content inventory, ensuring proper organization and availability of materials for airing.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in TV programming, channel scheduling, or media operations;
  • Familiarity with playout systems such as Media+, Imagine, or similar;
  • Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and agility in handling real-time adjustments;
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational teams;
  • Basic understanding of audience metrics and content performance indicators;
  • Proficiency in Excel and tools for content organization and control;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PT- BR

Visão Geral da Função:

Como Analista de Programação no SportyNet, você será responsável pela organização e atualização da grade diária de programação no sistema de playout, garantindo precisão, alinhamento técnico e aderência à estratégia editorial da empresa. Essa função exige atenção a detalhes, capacidade de resposta rápida a mudanças operacionais e colaboração próxima com as áreas técnica, editorial e de operações.

Responsabilidades:

  • Organizar, inserir e atualizar o roteiro diário de programação no sistema de playout (Media+ ou similar), assegurando que todas as informações de exibição estejam corretas e completas;
  • Realizar ajustes operacionais de última hora na grade, em função de alterações de conteúdo, transmissões ao vivo ou mudanças na estratégia editorial;
  • Monitorar a grade em tempo real, identificando inconsistências, conflitos técnicos ou operacionais, propondo soluções em conjunto com a coordenação;
  • Coletar e organizar dados de audiência das plataformas digitais e lineares, contribuindo para análises de desempenho de conteúdo;
  • Auxiliar na conferência e validação da grade de programação com o MCR e demais áreas técnicas, garantindo alinhamento entre o planejamento e a execução operacional;
  • Realizar o gerenciamento do acervo de conteúdos disponíveis para exibição, garantindo controle e organização dos arquivos.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em programação de TV, grade de canais ou operações de mídia
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de playout como Media+, Imagine, ou similares;
  • Raciocínio lógico, atenção a detalhes e agilidade para lidar com ajustes em tempo real;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e relacionamento com áreas técnicas;
  • Conhecimento básico de indicadores de audiência e comportamento de consumo;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de organização de conteúdo;
  • Ingles avançado / fluente

title: Especialista de Automação, Controle e Sensoriamento

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

  • Gympass;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Wind turbine bearing replacement (Visa needed) - Brasil
description:
Eosol Group is a leading company specializing in renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing high-quality maintenance and repair services for wind turbines. Our commitment to excellence and sustainability allows us to provide exceptional services to our clients, ensuring optimal performance and longevity of their wind energy systems. As we expand our operations in Peru, we are seeking a skilled Blades Repair Technician to join our dynamic team.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced wind turbine bearing replacement to be part of our team in USA. You will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of wind turbine. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in blade repair, be detail-oriented, and possess a strong problem-solving ability. A valid visa is necessary for this role as it involves working on-site in USA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspection: Visual inspection of bearings for signs of wear, corrosion, cracks or any other damage.
  • Testing: Perform vibration tests, oil analysis and other techniques to assess the condition of the bearings.
  • Disassembly and assembly: Careful disassembly of damaged or worn bearings and assembly of new bearings, following the manufacturer's specifications and using specialized tools.
  • Alignment and balancing: Ensure that bearings are correctly aligned and balanced to avoid vibration and premature failure.
  • Lubrication: Application of the correct amount of lubricant to ensure smooth operation and prevent wear.
  • Predictive maintenance: Implementation of predictive maintenance programs to monitor bearing condition and anticipate potential failures.
  • Repair: Repair of bearing-related components such as shafts, bearing housings and seals, if necessary.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year experience.
  • Current GWO courses.
  • Knowledge in wind turbine bearing replacement.
  • Change of residence.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing field with a focus on sustainability.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • The chance to be part of a company that values innovation and excellence in renewable energy solutions.

title: Gerente Regional de Vendas Jr
description:

Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua própria aventura profissional. Dê um passo para dentro da EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu #FutureInSight?

Responsável por liderar a estratégia de geração de demanda por meio da integração entre a visitação médica e o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos. Tem o papel de atuar como elo entre o time de campo, médicos, óticas e áreas internas, com foco em fortalecer a recomendação dos produtos EssilorLuxottica, desenvolver o negócio e impulsionar o sell-out no varejo, além de fazer a gestão do time de consultores.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de visitação médica com foco na recomendação e prescrição dos produtos, por meio de visitas regulares a oftalmologistas, utilizando materiais científicos e ferramentas de apoio à visita, como o C4C.
  • Estabelecer e fortalecer o relacionamento com líderes de opinião e sociedades médicas, participando de eventos, congressos e reuniões estratégicas, promovendo a marca e ampliando a influência da empresa no ecossistema médico.

  • Liderar iniciativas de capacitação científica e técnica, promovendo treinamentos para médicos e equipes de vendas das óticas, com foco em conhecimento técnico, diferenciais dos produtos e alinhamento com as estratégias da companhia.
  • Atuar como co-responsável pelo desempenho financeiro da regional, acompanhando indicadores como faturamento, margem e P&L (Profit & Loss), contribuindo com análises e decisões estratégicas para garantir a sustentabilidade e rentabilidade do negócio.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) relacionados à geração de demanda, utilizando ferramentas como BI e dashboards internos para análise de dados, identificação de oportunidades e definição de planos de ação personalizados por região ou cliente.
  • Planejar e executar o roteiro de visitas com base em critérios estratégicos de cobertura, frequência e potencial de prescrição, garantindo eficiência e impacto nas ações de campo.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com laboratórios, áreas internas e parceiros, promovendo uma atuação integrada que maximize os resultados da região sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos da Vaga:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas como Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimento em estratégias de geração de demanda e relacionamento com stakeholders médicos e donos das óticas.

  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo.

description:

Suprir a organização com um fluxo seguro de materiais e serviços para atendimento das necessidades, assegurando a continuidade de suprimentos, mantendo relacionamentos efetivos com fontes existentes e desenvolvendo fontes de suprimento alternativas. title: Section Manager
description:
Section Manager - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers.   • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
Job Description

About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. title: Hunter B2B de Publicidade
description:
Sobre a Orla Rio

Aqui, ativamos marcas com o pé na areia e o coração no lifestyle .

Nosso negócio é conectar grandes ideias a momentos inesquecíveis — do nascer ao pôr do sol.

Missão do cargo:

Sua missão será abrir caminhos.

O Hunter será responsável por desbravar novos mercados , identificar oportunidades, construir relacionamentos estratégicos e posicionar a Orla Rio como a plataforma de mídia mais desejada do país para marcas que querem se conectar com o público de forma autêntica, criativa e memorável.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os hubs de publicidade e com a área de growth para sinergia nas entregas.
  • Representar a Orla Rio como embaixador da nossa plataforma no mercado anunciante .

  • Hunter nato: tem brilho no olho por abrir negócios, sabe onde cutucar e não tem medo de porta fechada.

Modalidade PJ - Remuneração a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial) + comissão.

title: Gerente Contábil Sênior
description:
O que buscamos?

• Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado.

• Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis.

• Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade.

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of Technical Engineer, you will be responsible for managing a section of the build, ensuring that all designs are executed as per specifications, and any changes are effectively resolved and documented.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Liaise with planning teams to update working programmes and address technical queries from site.
  • Support temporary works design including tower cranes, hoists, and formwork systems.

  • Strong understanding of design review processes and technical coordination.

title: Test Manager/ Cutover manager
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Procuramos Test Manager/ Cutover manager que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Temos alguns requisitos:

  • Fluência em inglês é essencial para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 3x por semana presencial no cliente, e 2 remoto.
  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração de Empresas ou área correlata.
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos, especialmente em funções de gerenciamento de cutover e testes.
  • Sólido conhecimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) e metodologias de teste.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e projetos simultaneamente em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas e softwares de gerenciamento de projetos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejamento de Cutover: Desenvolver e gerenciar a estratégia de cutover, incluindo cronogramas, alocação de recursos e planos de gerenciamento de riscos para garantir uma transição bem-sucedida para novos sistemas.
  • Estratégia de Teste: Projetar e implementar estratégias abrangentes de teste, incluindo testes unitários, testes de integração, testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT) e testes de desempenho.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Liderar e coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo analistas de negócios, desenvolvedores e testadores de garantia de qualidade, para garantir uma colaboração eficaz durante as fases de cutover e teste.
  • Comunicação com as Partes Interessadas: Servir como o principal ponto de contato para as partes interessadas, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso, problemas e resoluções de cutover e teste.
  • Gerenciamento de Problemas: Identificar, rastrear e resolver problemas que surgem durante as fases de cutover e teste, garantindo que todos os problemas críticos sejam resolvidos prontamente.
  • Documentação: Manter documentação completa dos planos de cutover, procedimentos de teste, resultados e lições aprendidas para dar suporte a projetos futuros e requisitos de conformidade.
  • Treinamento e Suporte: Coordenar sessões de treinamento para usuários finais e equipes de suporte para garantir que estejam preparados para os novos sistemas e processos.
  • Revisão Pós-Transição: Realizar avaliações pós-transição para avaliar o sucesso da transição, coletar feedback e identificar áreas de melhoria.

O que oferecemos?

title: Manager, Domain Consulting - Network Security
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description

Your Career

As Domain Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your Domain Consultant team. Your team provides technical expertise and guidance in customers’ network security and zero trust journey. You will work closely with the Solutions Consultant Managers and their District Sales Manager counterparts to build relationships with your customers and help them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. You and your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and will evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security services that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

We seek a leader to develop our Domain Consultant teams, providing training and technical support as a solution expert. Additionally, you will provide feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on what you learn from your customer base. Your team, in partnership with the systems engineering team, will displace competitor technologies, build market share within your targeted list of major accounts, and, most importantly, help your client sleep at night as they use our products to build secure digital transactions.

Your Impact

  • Recruit and hire new Domain Consultants into the team, hiring the best talent in the industry

  • Work with your peers to develop a Domain Consultant training curriculum

  • Mentor, train, and review employees on your team, keeping them engaged and successful in their careers

  • Develop relationships with the Solutions Consultant Managers and their teams to ensure full technology coverage in key opportunities

  • Provide effective technical leadership in customer interactions, including sharing security trends and standard methodologies employed by other customers to actively be part of the selling process

  • Provide Domain Consultant expertise and fill in for existing team members if there is a resource conflict or vacation coverage challenge

  • Innovate and iterate to drive high technical validation and PoC win rates for Network Security solutions, while reducing technical validation and PoC timelines

  • Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO

  • Lead conversations focused on industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape

  • Discuss competitor offerings in the marketplace and positions ours as the best solution

  • Support your team in documenting HLD (High-Level Design) and key use cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions

  • Review and guide your team’s technical validation plans including POV (proof of value) test plans and customer readiness/requirements

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business

  • Act as an escalation point for pre-sales and collaborate with post-sales teams for issues that arise

  • Work with product teams to build requirements and roadmap development plans for our network security customers

  • Maintain a general understanding of competitor selling strategies

  • 50% travel within the region

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience managing customer-facing sales engineering or solutions architect teams

  • 5+ years experience in sales engineering within Zero Trust, Networking, Network Security, SaaS Security or SSE/SASE

  • Solid understanding of NGFW, Network Security, SASE, CASB, Proxy, DLP and BYOD solutions

  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts

  • Experience delivering comprehensive security solutions

  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

  • Experience in leading large teams, allocating resources, managing engagements and resource efficiency

  • Proficient in English

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Analista de requisitos
description:
Quem Somos

Especialista em Seguros Inovadores, a Essor traz em seu DNA inovação, excelência, experiência e conhecimento técnico. Somos uma Companhia do Grupo SCOR SE, uma das maiores resseguradoras mundiais e líder global de resseguros independente. Como empresa de um grupo internacional, a nossa cultura é definida pelo "The SCOR Way", que é baseado em cinco valores fundamentais:

  • Nós nos preocupamos com clientes, pessoas e sociedades;
  • Atuamos com integridade;
  • Agimos com coragem;
  • Encorajamos mentes abertas;
  • E nós prosperamos.

Por que Trabalhar conosco?

Como parte do time da INOVAÇÃO, você terá oportunidades de atuar nas mais diversas áreas, dando aos nossos colaboradores oportunidades de conhecimento e desenvolvimentos únicos.

Sobre Oportunidade

o Analista de Requisitos irá realizar levantamento de requisitos em colaboração com os usuários chaves de negócios para compreender o escopo de projetos. Identificar, definir e documentar requisitos de sistema e funcionalidades, utilizando técnicas como entrevistas, workshops e análise de documentos.

Escrever documentações detalhadas para o desenvolvimento pelo time.

Principais Atribuições

  • Criar e implementar simples CRUDs (Create, Read, Update, Delete) conforme as necessidades levantadas, garantindo a funcionalidade e usabilidade do sistema.
  • Colaborar com os stakeholders para garantir a compreensão mútua dos requisitos e facilitar a comunicação entre os envolvidos.
  • Avaliar impactos em demais projetos em andamento e em processos mplementados na seguradora.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as áreas de negócios e tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades em soluções estratégicas.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões, contribuindo com insights, esclarecimentos e refinamentos necessários para as histórias de usuário/EF/Casos de Uso.
  • Criar, revisar e manter a documentação dos requisitos, garantindo a precisão e atualização constante.
  • Analisar e otimizar processos, propondo melhorias para eficiência operacional e inovação tecnológica.
  • Participar do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a entrega, assegurando a aderência aos requisitos definidos.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital, elevando a experiência dos usuários e aprimorando operações.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência com transformação digital e novas tecnologias.
  • Vivência em projetos de inovação e automação de processos.
  • Background no mercado de seguros.
  • Experiência em levantamento e mapeamento de processos.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos de negócio.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis (Scrum).
  • Familiaridade com a criação de CRUDs (Create, Read, Update, Delete) e integrações via API.

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Gestão de Energia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar a gestão administrativa dos projetos da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (3 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Sales Development Representative (LATAM)
description:
The successful candidate will be a Portuguese and English speaker, based remotely in the LATAM region (preferably Brazil), to enable collaboration with the wider team and assist in their knowledge and skills development.

Our Sales Development team is the vanguard of our business, with Sales Development Reps (SDRs) driving interest in Absolute and initiating the sales cycle. In this role, you will collaborate with our Marketing and Account Executive teams to research and build a pipeline in new and existing accounts. You will follow up on both inbound and outbound leads predominately across Brazil and wider LATAM regions, engaging with prospects. Your exceptional communication and critical thinking skills will enable you to quickly assess opportunities and secure meetings with key account personas for our Account Executives. You’ll drive revenue growth from new account acquisitions and foster expansion and cross-sell opportunities with existing customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate and qualify leads, identifying prospects genuinely interested in our cybersecurity solutions
  • Prioritize and research prospects, understanding their current IT situation, challenges, and needs
  • Engage prospective clients via phone, email, and social media (LinkedIn) to convey Absolute’s unique value propositions
  • Schedule qualified meetings for Sales through cold calling and strategic outreach, converting them into pipeline opportunities
  • Build and prioritize strategic account lists within a defined segment
  • Foster alignment and positive partnerships with internal Field Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participate in virtual and/or in-person events as needed
  • Utilize our CRM system (Salesforce) to log activity and lead conversion data for business transparency
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

Requirements:

  • Portuguese language and English proficiency essential . Additional language capabilities, especially Spanish is desirable
  • Resilience and a fearless approach to challenges, particularly in objection handling
  • Strong communication skills for effective interaction with customers, prospects, and team members
  • Ambitious individuals eager to learn and contribute significantly to the business's continued success
  • Previous sales experience (1-3 years preferred) with a proven track record of consistently opening qualified opportunities that lead to revenue
  • Experience in B2B lead generation, ideally within the cybersecurity space, is a bonus but not essential

Why Work For Us:

Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
