title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE

Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.

About Us

Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.

The opportunity

The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

What working at Core42 offers

With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.

  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience
  • Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
  • Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
  • Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family
  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: Engenheiro de Projetos de Carbono Pleno
description:
A Neoenergia se une, em mais uma nova parceria com o grupo Iberdrola, para criar a Carbon2Nature Brasil. A iniciativa reforça estratégias corporativas e diversifica a rede de projetos, gerando valor e rentabilidade sustentáveis. A joint venture conta com uma participação de 49% da Neoenergia, e 51% pela Carbon2Nature.

A Carbon2Nature Brasil tem como um dos principais objetivos desenvolver parcerias e projetos que capturam carbono por meio de soluções baseadas na natureza, gerando um impacto positivo na biodiversidade, no clima e nas comunidades locais, bem como promovendo uma economia sustentável.

Com foco no desenvolvimento de projetos de restauração e conservação da natureza, contribui com os objetivos de descarbonização por meio da comercialização de crédito de carbono de alta qualidade e financia medidas adicionais de mitigação climática para seus clientes.

Sua energia será muito importante para :

Executar e realizar monitoramento técnico de projetos voltados à geração de créditos de carbono de alta qualidade, conforme padrões e certificações nacionais e internacionais (como Verra, Gold Standard e regulamentos brasileiros). Além de atuar garantindo a integridade técnica, cumprimento de prazos, físicos e financeiros, rastreabilidade e conformidade dos projetos em diferentes regiões do país, com base operacional no Rio de Janeiro.

Atividades:

  • Analisar e criticar curvas de biomassa e remoção de carbono dos projetos, por meio da análise técnica e das medidas de mitigação implementadas, visando apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade técnica de novos projetos, por meio de estudos preliminares, avaliação de elegibilidade e levantamento de dados de campo, em diferentes biomas brasileiros;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento técnico em campo dos projetos, por meio de visitas periódicas, verificação da execução das atividades e coleta de dados primários, assegurando a aderência às metodologias e a qualidade das informações reportadas;
  • Assegurar a regularidade ambiental e social dos projetos, por meio do acompanhamento e suporte técnico aos processos de licenciamento ambiental junto aos órgãos competentes, em conformidade com a legislação vigente;
  • Manter atualizados os sistemas de rastreabilidade e controle de dados dos projetos, por meio da organização de bases de dados, planilhas e plataformas digitais, garantindo a integridade das informações;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos projetos, através da criação e análise de indicadores, imagens geoespaciais e relatórios técnicos, com base em parâmetros definidos pelas certificadoras;
  • Desenvolver relatórios técnicos e documentos de suporte à gestão, mediante organização de dados, sistematização de evidências e elaboração de materiais para validação e verificação externa;
  • Prezar pelos valores de Saúde, Segurança, Sustentabilidade, e Meio Ambiente disseminados pela companhia por meio de campanhas e políticas, aplicando seus princípios em todas as ações, processos e diretrizes da empresa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Florestal ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência na elaboração de Protocolos e metodologias de certificação de carbono (ex: Verra/VCS, Gold Standard, entre outros);
  • Modelagem e monitoramento de projetos de carbono;
  • Conhecimento Geoprocessamento e sensoriamento remoto aplicados a projetos ambientais (uso de QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine);
  • Conhecimento de Normas e regulamentações ambientais brasileiras, incluindo processos de licenciamento ambiental em âmbito federal, estadual e municipal;
  • Vivência em Gestão de dados e elaboração de relatórios técnicos para auditorias e validações externas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI, Python ou R são diferenciais);
  • Conhecimento de implantação de projetos florestais em campo;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de restauração florestal;
  • Vivência em Gestão de projetos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Inglês – avançado;
  • CNH – B.

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano;
  • Licença maternidade estendida , para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença paternidade , para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos , porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Trabalho Híbrido para colaboradores administrativos;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos;
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.

title: Bim Modeler - MEP
description:
MEP BIM Modeler - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a BIM Modeler, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming design information into precise 3D models and construction documents. You’ll support our field operations with shop drawings, schedules, and coordinated data, driving project accuracy and collaboration forward.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Review tender and IFC information (2D drawings, BIM models, asset data) per ISO19650 standards
  • Create and maintain Revit-based BIM models, including GA plans, sections, diagrams, and schedules
  • Perform clash detection and support clash avoidance coordination
  • Maintain clean, healthy BIM models following industry best practices
  • Update and revise models/documents based on RFIs, design changes, and site instructions
  • Identify inconsistencies in contract documents and flag them appropriately
  • Assist with as-built documentation and handover preparation
  • Work collaboratively in shared environments (CDE), supporting both internal and external teams
  • Follow project standards, templates, protocols, and document control procedures
  • Provide accurate technical responses to site queries and requests

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical Diploma in Architecture, Civil or Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum 3 years of BIM experience on construction projects
  • Proficient in Revit and AutoCAD
  • Familiarity with CDE platforms and coordination tools (Revizto, Navisworks)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat
  • Understanding of BIM principles and workflows
  • Strong written and spoken English skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Educational Technology Specialist
description:
JOB MISSION:

Provide essential support to educators, and students through faculty, and the IT department in facilitating the effective use of technology for teaching and learning. This includes assisting with the integration of technology into the curriculum, troubleshooting technical issues, and promoting digital literacy among students and faculty to enhance the overall educational experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide advanced technical support to teachers and students, assisting with software and hardware issues, troubleshooting, and resolving technical challenges in the classroom and events;
  • Manage and organize digital resources, including educational software, e-books, and online materials, making them readily accessible to educators and students;
  • Facilitate training sessions and workshops for teachers and staff to enhance their digital literacy skills and proficiency with educational technology tools;
  • Assist students in using technology for academic purposes, provide guidance on research and digital projects, and foster responsible digital citizenship;
  • Ensure that classroom technology equipment, such as interactive whiteboards, projectors, and tablets, is properly set up and maintained for instructional use;
  • Collaborate with the IT department to communicate and prioritize technical needs in educational settings, ensuring the seamless functioning of technology resources;
  • Promote digital safety and responsible online behavior among students, guiding them in understanding privacy, cyberbullying prevention, and ethical technology use;
  • Collaborate with educators to integrate technology into lesson plans and curriculum, ensuring that digital tools enhance learning outcomes and align with educational goals;
  • Assist with data entry, management, and analysis related to student performance and digital learning tools, helping educators make data-informed decisions;
  • Ensure that digital resources and technology tools are accessible to all students, including those with disabilities, and provide support in implementing accessibility features;
  • Maintain an inventory of educational technology equipment, track its condition, and coordinate repairs or replacements as needed.

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.

Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction

What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

Electrify Your Career with StarCharge South America ⚡

title: Digital Construction Manager
description:
Digital Construction Manager - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.

Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em ambientes altamente escaláveis, capazes de suportar milhões de transações e requisições diariamente. Atualmente, o ambiente processa cerca de 2 a 3 milhões de requisições por dia e mais de 70 milhões por mês. O foco principal é o desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações distribuídas, com forte atuação em microsserviços e mensageria.

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

- Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

- Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura na AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

- Desenvolver integrações assíncronas utilizando RabbitMQ, Kafka e outras ferramentas de mensageria;

- Monitorar e escalar sistemas distribuídos de alta performance;

- Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB);

- Garantir boas práticas de segurança, performance e resiliência.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

- Experiência prática com AWS e suas principais ferramentas;

- Conhecimento sólido em RabbitMQ ou tecnologias similares de mensageria;

- Domínio em arquitetura de microsserviços;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL);

- Vivência com MongoDB ou outros bancos NoSQL;

- Atuação com CI/CD, Git e metodologias ágeis.

Diferenciais:

- Certificações AWS;

- Experiência com outras clouds (Azure, GCP);

- Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Formato de Trabalho:

  • Híbrido: 3 vezes por semana no escritório, localizado no Rio de Janeiro.

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Colaborar com a equipe criativa para desenvolver conceitos visuais: Como parte da equipe criativa, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outros membros da equipe para desenvolver conceitos visuais que estejam alinhados à nossa marca e missão. Gerenciar e organizar todo o material de vídeo: Você será responsável por manter todos os materiais de vídeo organizados e acessíveis. Isso irá garantir que o processo de produção de vídeo seja o mais eficiente possível.

Qualidade dos vídeos produzidos: A qualidade dos vídeos que você produz é crucial. Estaremos avaliando a qualidade com base em uma variedade de fatores, incluindo a clareza das imagens, a qualidade do som e a coerência da edição. Cumprimento dos prazos de entrega: A capacidade de cumprir prazos é essencial. Estaremos avaliando sua eficácia em entregar projetos dentro do prazo estabelecido. Satisfação do cliente com os produtos finais: A satisfação do cliente é uma medida importante do sucesso dos seus vídeos. Os produtos finais devem atender ou superar as expectativas do cliente. Contribuição para o alcance dos objetivos de marketing: Seu trabalho deve contribuir de maneira significativa para o alcance de nossos objetivos de marketing. Isso será avaliado com base em como seus vídeos ajudam a aumentar a conscientização da marca, gerar leads e converter client

title: Editor de Vídeo
description:
Cargo:

Editor de vídeo

Sobre a empresa:

A Full Sales System uma empresa de estruturação de processos e times comerciais.

Estamos aqui para dar voz ao empresário , para que ele se veja como peça-chave da economia. O comercial movimenta, mas é o empreendedor quem faz a máquina girar. E nós somos a engrenagem que dá estrutura a esse processo, ajudando a escalar negócios de forma sólida e estratégica.

A Full Sales System é para quem tem sede de crescimento, quem quer fazer parte de algo inovador e transformar realidades. ;

Missão:

Como Editor de Vídeo, você terá uma missão crucial na nossa organização. Será responsável por capturar, editar e produzir vídeos para uma variedade de propósitos – redes sociais, anúncios, divulgação interna, material de apoio – sejam eles curtos ou longos.

Seu trabalho abrangerá uma ampla gama de projetos, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, vídeos promocionais, documentários e filmes corporativos. Seus esforços serão significativos para ajudar a alcançar nossos objetivos de marketing e branding, e nos permitir comunicar de forma eficaz com nosso público-alvo.

Sua função:

Editar imagens em vídeo, garantindo a mais alta qualidade possível: Você será responsável por garantir que todo o conteúdo que editar seja de uma qualidade excepcional. Isso requer uma compreensão profunda de edição para vídeos nos formatos vertical e horizontal. Habilidades em edição: É essencial que possua habilidades sólidas em softwares de edição de vídeo e entenda como criar um criativo de alta qualidade que irá performar bem nas plataformas digitais. Colaborar com a equipe criativa para desenvolver conceitos visuais: Como parte da equipe criativa, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outros membros da equipe para desenvolver conceitos visuais que estejam alinhados à nossa marca e missão. Isso requer a capacidade de pensar de forma criativa e colaborativa. Trabalhar com a equipe de marketing para garantir que os vídeos atendam às metas de marketing e branding: Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com a equipe de marketing para garantir que os vídeos produzidos estejam alinhados com nossos objetivos de branding e marketing. Isso requer a capacidade de entender e aplicar estratégias de marketing em seu trabalho. Gerenciar e organizar todo o material de vídeo: Você será responsável por manter todos os materiais de vídeo organizados e acessíveis. Isso irá garantir que o processo de produção de vídeo seja o mais eficiente possível.

KPIs

Qualidade dos vídeos produzidos: A qualidade dos vídeos que você produz é crucial. Estaremos avaliando a qualidade com base em uma variedade de fatores, incluindo a clareza das imagens, a qualidade do som e a coerência da edição. Cumprimento dos prazos de entrega: A capacidade de cumprir prazos é essencial. Estaremos avaliando sua eficácia em entregar projetos dentro do prazo estabelecido. Satisfação do cliente com os produtos finais: A satisfação do cliente é uma medida importante do sucesso dos seus vídeos. Os produtos finais devem atender ou superar as expectativas do cliente. Contribuição para o alcance dos objetivos de marketing: Seu trabalho deve contribuir de maneira significativa para o alcance de nossos objetivos de marketing. Isso será avaliado com base em como seus vídeos ajudam a aumentar a conscientização da marca, gerar leads e converter clientes.

O que oferemos:

Vale alimentação de R$28,99

Day Off de aniversário

Acesso a banco de imagens, trilhas e recursos pagos para edição

Liberdade criativa dentro do estilo da marca

Possibilidade de crescimento para cargo

Ambiente colaborativo com equipe de marketing e criativos

Treinamentos e feedbacks constantes para evolução técnica e criativo

O que você precisa:

Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos e longos (institucionais, redes sociais, reels, cortes de podcast, etc.)

Portfólio atualizado com produções próprias (obrigatório)

Domínio de softwares de edição: Adobe Premiere, After Effects, CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve ou similares

Conhecimento básico de design gráfico (para apoio visual e motion simples)

Noções de narrativa, ritmo e transições modernas

Capacidade de seguir identidade visual e linguagem da marca

Organização de arquivos e projetos em nuvem (Google Drive, Wetransfer, etc.)

Familiaridade com redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok)

Notebook ou computador

Boa comunicação com o time de marketing e roteiristas

Comprometimento com prazos e revisões

Acompanhar o desempenho da equipe, promovendo feedbacks estruturados e rituais de desenvolvimento. Estar presente na rotina das unidades, orientando e acompanhando processos operacionais.

Manter relacionamento próximo com investidores locais e parceiros estratégicos. Atuar como elo entre a unidade e áreas corporativas como Produto, Marketing, Tecnologia e Gente & Gestão. Acompanhar o desempenho financeiro e contribuir para o atingimento do ROI.

Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão Empresarial, Engenharia, Hotelaria ou áreas correlatas.

Sólida vivência em posições de liderança operacional (mínimo de 5 anos). Experiência comprovada na gestão de manutenção predial e infraestrutura (mínimo de 2 anos). Atuação prévia com múltiplos sites, estruturas prediais complexas ou operações de hospitalidade/coliving/hotelaria. Desejável vivência com planejamento estratégico, gestão de KPIs e análise de indicadores financeiros.

Visão sistêmica e capacidade de planejamento de longo prazo. Capacidade analítica para tomada de decisões baseadas em dados. Excelente comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders. Postura protagonista e atitude de dono(a). Empatia, escuta ativa e forte senso de responsabilidade ética. Adaptabilidade a contextos dinâmicos, mudanças de rota e cenários de incerteza. Proatividade, resiliência e criatividade para resolução de problemas.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage


(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility


What We’re Looking For:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture



Who is Xelvin?


Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.


Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!


As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.


What do we offer?


Contract wise:


· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)



Onboarding & benefits:


· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.


· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.


· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.


· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.


· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.


· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;


o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.


o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”)..
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

title: Analista de requisitos
description:

title: Project Manager for Brazil (Utility)
description:
Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc., -– short Hoymiles (688032.SH)-is a globally leading inverter manufacturer with offices and services around the globe. The headquarters is based in Hangzhou China and the R&D department and manufacturing facilities are based there. Hoymiles has a significant R&D team to design and manufacture state-of-the art microinverters & hybird inverter for the international markets. To develop our business in Brazil and deliver better service to our customer, build a strong technical support structure we are looking for an experienced Project Manager for Delivery of Utility in Brazil , reporting to head of technical support HQ .



Key responsibilities


1. Collaborate with sales team to plan and complete technical exchange with Brazil customers, train clients and set forth detailed technical solutions etc.

2. Hold customer trainings face-to-face and online, create and manage local technical documentation, establish a knowledge data base, and represent Hoymiles in exhibitions.

3. Analyze legal technical requirements and certifications for local and drive execution of agreed and required certificates.

4. Monitor market environment and gather Technology intelligence from competitors.Analyze product and features of competitors regular and work closely with HQ team to finish the competitive analysis.

5. Strong support to sales team, visit clients and project sites, support system planning and give guidance to PV system installations, service strategy implementation etc.

6. Maintain the service level and fulfill the service request coming from local customer especially some of our VIP customer.

7. Lead the negotiation with local service partner including 3rd party service company.

8. Follow RMA process to make sure they will be closed on-time.


Required experience and competence:

1. Based in Brazil . Can accept national travel to make sure we can deliver a good service, depends on business request.

2. Português at a native level and English fluently in business contexts.

3. Minimum of 3 years work experience in a in the renewable industry, preferably in Storage business.

4. electrician certificate is mandatory.

5. Bachelor degree or above: must be electrical or electronics background.

6. Self-driven working mind set, willing to dig in and find out problems, report with clear logic, always providing multi proposals to choose from.

7. International mindset for a multi-cultural environment.

title: Gerente Financeiro/Administrativo - Rio de Janeiro
description:

A Every Cybersecurity, GRC and Privacy Solutions é uma empresa especializada em Segurança da Informação, Governança, Riscos, Compliance (GRC) e Privacidade de Dados. Atuamos com projetos de consultoria altamente especializada, oferecendo soluções em cibersegurança, conformidade regulatória, proteção de dados e governança corporativa.


**Vaga presencial para o Rio de Janeiro - RJ**


Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Desenvolver normas e procedimentos administrativos para orientação e padronização de rotinas, fluxos de trabalho e diretrizes visando a melhoria na qualidade dos serviços.
  • Gerenciar as funções Administrativas da equipe (cotações, acompanhamento de prestações de serviços como limpeza, contabilidade, jurídico, documentação de colaboradores, compras de materiais diversos);
  • Contratar/Coordenar atividades de prestadores de serviços administrativos e de serviços gerais na Every;

  • Criar índices de performance;
  • Definir e acompanhar todas as atividades a serem realizadas pela equipe administrativa financeira;
  • Administrar os escritórios;
  • Gerenciar a equipe administrativa e financeira;
  • Acompanhamento de contratos.
  • Gerenciar processos de contas a pagar/receber, controle de fluxo de caixa, balanço, planejamento e execução orçamentária, previsão de receitas e outras.
  • Realizar classificação contábil, estudos, análises de viabilidade econômica, conciliação e análise de fechamento de custos;
  • Construir relatórios Operacionais e Estratégicos: assessoria para tomada de decisão podendo ser composto por informações financeiras, projeções de investimentos, equipe, processos e cenários futuros.
  • Montar e apresentar os indicadores de desempenho do departamento financeiro, como tempo médio de recebimento, tempo médio de pagamento, nível de inadimplência, os clientes mais rentáveis da empresa entre outros.
  • Acompanhamento de Resultados: monitoramento e gestão de indicadores e situação econômico-financeira da organização. Comparar resultados previstos e atuais e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Atualização sobre o mercado financeiro avaliando e comparando taxas bancárias, taxas de juros e aplicações, prestação de serviços, despesas diversas além de atualizar o cadastro da empresa junto ás instituições bancárias para manutenção das linhas de crédito visando os menores custos e melhor qualidade de atendimento bem como acompanha a legislação tributária, financeira e contábil para adequação da empresa às normas vigentes, obtenção de benefícios fiscais ou orientações junto à empresa terceirizada para os serviços contábeis.
  • Preparar o fechamento financeiro do período, para controle e providencias do superior. Relacionar o movimento de contas a pagar e a receber, crédito e débito de juros, receitas e despesas financeiras, taxas de financiamento e investimento praticadas bem como projeta o fluxo para o período seguinte viabilizando a captação de recursos ou aplicações.
  • Apurar e analisar indicadores econômicos-financeiros para subsidiar o planejamento estratégico da empresa em conjunto com a Diretoria. Responsabilizar-se pela aplicação dos conceitos do BSC (Balanced Scorecard) reunindo-se com a Diretoria e áreas da empresa para definição e implantação de planos de ação que comporão a estratégia da empresa para o período.
  • Preparar projeções de custos e elaboração de orçamentos (para departamentos e projetos);

title: Especialista de Automação, Controle e Sensoriamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

  • Experiência com gestão de projetos de automação.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Sales Development Representative (LATAM)
description:
The successful candidate will be a Portuguese and English speaker, based remotely in the LATAM region (preferably Brazil), to enable collaboration with the wider team and assist in their knowledge and skills development.


Our Sales Development team is the vanguard of our business, with Sales Development Reps (SDRs) driving interest in Absolute and initiating the sales cycle. In this role, you will collaborate with our Marketing and Account Executive teams to research and build a pipeline in new and existing accounts. You will follow up on both inbound and outbound leads predominately across Brazil and wider LATAM regions, engaging with prospects. Your exceptional communication and critical thinking skills will enable you to quickly assess opportunities and secure meetings with key account personas for our Account Executives. You’ll drive revenue growth from new account acquisitions and foster expansion and cross-sell opportunities with existing customers.


Responsibilities:

  • Generate and qualify leads, identifying prospects genuinely interested in our cybersecurity solutions
  • Prioritize and research prospects, understanding their current IT situation, challenges, and needs
  • Engage prospective clients via phone, email, and social media (LinkedIn) to convey Absolute’s unique value propositions
  • Schedule qualified meetings for Sales through cold calling and strategic outreach, converting them into pipeline opportunities
  • Build and prioritize strategic account lists within a defined segment
  • Foster alignment and positive partnerships with internal Field Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participate in virtual and/or in-person events as needed
  • Utilize our CRM system (Salesforce) to log activity and lead conversion data for business transparency
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers


Requirements:

  • Portuguese language and English proficiency essential . Additional language capabilities, especially Spanish is desirable
  • Resilience and a fearless approach to challenges, particularly in objection handling
  • Strong communication skills for effective interaction with customers, prospects, and team members
  • Ambitious individuals eager to learn and contribute significantly to the business's continued success
  • Previous sales experience (1-3 years preferred) with a proven track record of consistently opening qualified opportunities that lead to revenue
  • Experience in B2B lead generation, ideally within the cybersecurity space, is a bonus but not essential



Why Work For Us:


You’re resilient and passionate about securing the Work from Anywhere era. So are we.


We’re in search of the best and the brightest – everyone from innovators, sellers and marketers to financers, operators and especially customer relationship managers – we’re looking for top tier talent to help us shape the next decade of security, drive innovation that enables customers with truly disruptive solutions and are dedicated to making a meaningful difference.


Headquartered in Seattle, Washington with international offices in Vancouver - BC, Austin - TX, Boulder - CO, Ankeny – IA, Reading - UK and Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam, Absolute Security accelerates customers’ shift to work-from-anywhere through the industry’s first self-healing Zero Trust platform, ensuring maximum security and uncompromised productivity. Only Absolute is embedded in more than half a billion devices, offering a permanent digital connection that intelligently and dynamically applies visibility, control and self-healing capabilities to endpoints, applications, and network access to ensure their cyber resilience tailored for distributed workforces.


Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Absolute currently serves approximately 16,000 customers with more than 13 million activated endpoints globally. G2 recognized Absolute as a Leader in the Winter 2022 Endpoint Management and Zero Trust Networking Grid Reports, reflecting our continued customer satisfaction across product lines. To learn more about Absolute, visit our website at or visit our YouTube channel

Nosso portfólio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua própria aventura profissional. Dê um passo para dentro da EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu #FutureInSight?


Se interessou? Veja a descrição da atividade:

Responsável por liderar a estratégia de geração de demanda por meio da integração entre a visitação médica e o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos. Tem o papel de atuar como elo entre o time de campo, médicos, óticas e áreas internas, com foco em fortalecer a recomendação dos produtos EssilorLuxottica, desenvolver o negócio e impulsionar o sell-out no varejo, além de fazer a gestão do time de consultores.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de visitação médica com foco na recomendação e prescrição dos produtos, por meio de visitas regulares a oftalmologistas, utilizando materiais científicos e ferramentas de apoio à visita, como o C4C.
  • Estabelecer e fortalecer o relacionamento com líderes de opinião e sociedades médicas, participando de eventos, congressos e reuniões estratégicas, promovendo a marca e ampliando a influência da empresa no ecossistema médico.
  • Atuar em parceria com o time comercial das óticas e de marketing, garantindo o alinhamento entre as ações de campo e as campanhas, contribuindo diretamente para o aumento do sell-out nas óticas.

1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.

  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo?

title: Wind turbine bearing replacement (Visa needed) - Brasil
description:
Eosol Group is a leading company specializing in renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing high-quality maintenance and repair services for wind turbines. Our commitment to excellence and sustainability allows us to provide exceptional services to our clients, ensuring optimal performance and longevity of their wind energy systems. As we expand our operations in Peru, we are seeking a skilled Blades Repair Technician to join our dynamic team.


Job Summary


We are looking for an experienced wind turbine bearing replacement to be part of our team in USA. You will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of wind turbine. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in blade repair, be detail-oriented, and possess a strong problem-solving ability. A valid visa is necessary for this role as it involves working on-site in USA.


Key Responsibilities


  • Inspection: Visual inspection of bearings for signs of wear, corrosion, cracks or any other damage.
  • Testing: Perform vibration tests, oil analysis and other techniques to assess the condition of the bearings.
  • Disassembly and assembly: Careful disassembly of damaged or worn bearings and assembly of new bearings, following the manufacturer's specifications and using specialized tools.
  • Alignment and balancing: Ensure that bearings are correctly aligned and balanced to avoid vibration and premature failure.
  • Lubrication: Application of the correct amount of lubricant to ensure smooth operation and prevent wear.
  • Predictive maintenance: Implementation of predictive maintenance programs to monitor bearing condition and anticipate potential failures.
  • Repair: Repair of bearing-related components such as shafts, bearing housings and seals, if necessary.


Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year experience.
  • Current GWO courses.
  • Knowledge in wind turbine bearing replacement.
  • Change of residence.


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing field with a focus on sustainability.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • The chance to be part of a company that values innovation and excellence in renewable energy solutions.

title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE


Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.


About Us


Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.


The opportunity


The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.


Your Key Responsibilities


  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency


What we're looking for


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.


What working at Core42 offers


With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.


  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience
  • Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
  • Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
  • Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family
  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, Itália França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite .

- Auxílio na gestão e acompanhamento de processos judiciais;

- Auxílio na prestação de consultoria jurídica para todas as áreas de negócio.

- Executar outras tarefas correlatas, a critério do superior imediato.

REQUISITOS:

Cursando no mínimo o 4º período do curso de Direito;

Inglês básico;

Pacote Office nível intermediário;

title: Analista de Planejamento Srº
description:
A Tupperware é uma empresa global que valoriza a Diversidade, a Equidade e a Inclusão e onde todas as pessoas candidatas são bem-vindas!


Já pensou em fazer parte deste time?

Temos uma oportunidade para você aqui na #Tupperware!


Buscamos uma pessoa para ser Analista de Planejamento Srº, sendo responsável negociar e planejar a disponibilidade de moldes a nível Global e controlar os processos de Importação e Exportação dos moldes, através da coordenação toda a logística, pré e pós desembaraço aduaneiro, a fim de que os moldes sejam liberados no menor tempo possível e ao menor custo


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Negociar e identificar a logística do molde para análise de cenários (atividade de movimentação de moldes) e componentes entre todas as unidades de produção da Tupperware; considerando os seguintes os requisitos de MKT e de nível de serviço, a produção de níveis de estoque e o fornecimento e planejamento da capacidade (Plano logístico);
  • Garantir que os recursos necessários (pilhas, estruturas, canal, molde completo ou outros componentes) estarão disponíveis para produção em tempo e em boas condições, a fim de viabilizar o cumprimento do ciclo de produção necessário;
  • Analisar, responder e programar os empréstimos de moldes de maneira oportuna para outras unidades de produção, a fim de garantir o atendimento das necessidades de molde de outros países sem afetar a estratégia comercial local;
  • Garantir que as atividades relacionadas à logística de moldes sejam realizadas respeitando os critérios de custos, tempo e qualidade e de forma totalmente aderente à norma Tupperware, conforme Manual Global do Planejamento;
  • Executar toda a rotina relacionada aos processos de Importação e Exportação, realizando follow-up do início ao fim do processo e garantindo o cumprimento da Legislação aduaneira e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Monitorar os pontos de auditoria ISO, através de constantes revisões de processos e garantindo a conformidade do sistema de gestão;
  • Atuar no controle e monitoramento do serviço dos fornecedores, através de planilha de avaliação de performance, a fim de garantir que os prestadores de serviço estão atendendo aos requisitos mínimos exigidos.



Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção e áreas afins;
  • MBA em Logística, Gestão de negócios ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório);



Habilidades:

  • Comunicação e Negociação;
  • Capacidade crítica;
  • Relacionamento.



Nossos Valores:

  • Fazemos o que é certo;
  • Temos sucesso como um time;
  • Sempre evoluímos.


Deu match com seu perfil e momento profissional? Se sim, inscreva-se até o dia 25/07/2025 para participar do processo seletivo!

title: Consultor - Central de Laudos (Exames de Imagens) - Corporativo RJ
