title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE


Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.


Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Hunter B2B de Publicidade
description:
Sobre a Orla Rio

Somos a maior plataforma de experiências ao ar livre do Brasil.

Com mais de 300 quiosques espalhados pela orla carioca , transformamos a praia em um palco vivo de gastronomia, lazer, cultura, bem-estar e... publicidade com alma.

Aqui, ativamos marcas com o pé na areia e o coração no lifestyle .

Nosso negócio é conectar grandes ideias a momentos inesquecíveis — do nascer ao pôr do sol.


Missão do cargo:

Sua missão será abrir caminhos.

O Hunter será responsável por desbravar novos mercados , identificar oportunidades, construir relacionamentos estratégicos e posicionar a Orla Rio como a plataforma de mídia mais desejada do país para marcas que querem se conectar com o público de forma autêntica, criativa e memorável.


Você será protagonista na construção de parcerias com marcas e agências que enxergam valor em estar onde o Rio pulsa.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e prospectar novos anunciantes e agências nos segmentos mais estratégicos (moda, bebidas, turismo, entretenimento, tecnologia, saúde, esportes...).
  • Identificar oportunidades ligadas ao calendário cultural e turístico do Rio .
  • Apresentar soluções como ativações de marca, publicidade OOH, experiências proprietárias e naming rights .
  • Gerar reuniões para os closers.
  • Criar e adaptar propostas comerciais.
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais iniciais e propor soluções personalizadas com olhar consultivo .
  • Alimentar e gerenciar o CRM com disciplina, inteligência e visão de pipeline.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os hubs de publicidade e com a área de growth para sinergia nas entregas.
  • Representar a Orla Rio como embaixador da nossa plataforma no mercado anunciante .


Perfil ideal:

  • Hunter nato: tem brilho no olho por abrir negócios, sabe onde cutucar e não tem medo de porta fechada.
  • Pensamento consultivo: você não vende mídia — você cria soluções que fazem sentido para a marca.
  • Repertório criativo: acompanha campanhas, entende timing cultural, vive o mercado publicitário.
  • Comunicação afiada: sabe apresentar, encantar e convencer.
  • Relacionamento estratégico: tem (ou constrói) rede forte com agências, marcas e tomadores de decisão.
  • Mentalidade de crescimento: espírito de dono(a), foco em resultado e vontade de fazer acontecer.


Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior em vendas B2B — preferencialmente em publicidade, mídia OOH, ativações ou brand experience.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências e das dinâmicas de marketing e trade marketing das grandes marcas.
  • Vivência em funções como SDR, pré-vendas, inside sales ou hunter.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Organização, foco, resiliência e autogestão.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM como RD Station , Ramper ou similares.
  • Capacidade de pensar como estrategista, agir como vendedor(a) e se portar como parceiro de negócios.


Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado com projetos especiais, experiências de marca ou ativações em campo.
  • Conhecimento da cultura carioca, comportamento de consumo de praia e lifestyle local.
  • Portfólio de clientes relevantes ou histórico de contas de impacto.
  • Inglês fluente: leitura, escrita e conversação.


Remuneração:

Modalidade PJ - Remuneração a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial) + comissão.


Se você acredita que o melhor da vida acontece ao ar livre , sabe como contar boas histórias com marcas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está redesenhando o jeito de viver (e anunciar) no Rio , esse é o seu lugar.

title: BMS Commissioning Engineer
description:

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.


Why Join Us?

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll lead the commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS) across key project sections. From planning resources to optimizing system performance, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring high-quality installations and efficient site execution.


At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.


Your Role

  • Conduct all BMS commissioning phases: Pre-functional, Functional, and Integrated Systems Testing
  • Perform software/hardware integration with third-party systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system defects, supporting other trades and contractors
  • Develop, test, and commission BMS control programs based on detailed Sequences of Operation
  • Oversee Site Acceptance Tests and demonstrate systems to consultants and clients
  • Fine-tune system parameters to meet design intent and maximize energy efficiency
  • Manage installation teams and day-to-day site activities, including labor, materials, and equipment
  • Coordinate with the commissioning manager and document all commissioning activities
  • Ensure all technical documentation, QA/QC protocols, and HSE compliance are maintained
  • Control drawing management and track updates for as-built submissions
  • Record team efficiencies and report delays, constraints, or deviations
  • Oversee handover documentation, including spares, warranty details, and compliance statements


What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering (required)
  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on commissioning experience, especially in BMS and integrated systems
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, and communication abilities
  • Proven success handling teams, budgets, and project timelines
  • Ability to work under pressure with autonomy and precision
  • Familiar with project specifications, construction drawings, and commercial coordination


What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.


Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Gestão de Energia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar a gestão administrativa dos projetos da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (3 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.


Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.


Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.



What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Senior Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Senior Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Senior Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be re sponsible for overseeing information management using BIM (Building Information Modeling) across the project, ensuring all stakeholders meet digital deliverables and project requirements. While the role may involve other digital construction methods such as scanning, drones, and robotics, the primary focus is BIM. The coordinator serves as the main point of contact for BIM between the project management team and external stakeholders including the client, consultants, and subcontractors.


Your Role:

  • Manage and interpret client BIM expectations and deliverables.
  • Communicate information requirements internally and externally.
  • Develop and maintain BIM documentation such as the BIM execution plan, exchange information requirements, responsibility matrix, and master information delivery plan.
  • Set up and manage BIM workflows from contract award through project handover.
  • Ensure the electronic document management system supports the common data environment processes.
  • Lead 3D model coordination and issue resolution, including clash detection.
  • Provide training, coaching, and support for BIM processes and related technologies.
  • Estimate resource requirements for direct and subcontracted works.
  • Implement quality assurance and control for models and BIM processes.
  • Represent BIM and digital construction at project meetings.
  • Report on BIM progress and compliance at the project level.
  • Support tender submissions and contribute to departmental process development.


What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and familiarity with the 1192 standards.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring software such as Revit, Tekla, or Archicad.
  • Experience with BIM coordination tools such as Navisworks or Revizto.
  • Knowledge of openBIM standards including IFC and COBie.
  • Ability to use tools for automated model checking and data validation such as Solibri.
  • Experience with cloud-based collaboration platforms used in CDE workflows such as Aconex or BIM 360.
  • Familiarity with scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Experience in programming or visual programming (Dynamo preferred).
  • Understanding of 4D and 5D processes and their implementation.
  • Ability to use data reporting tools such as MS Power BI.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable with a proactive mindset.
  • Confident, assertive, and resilient under pressure.
  • Analytical with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Highly organized with excellent time management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation in construction.


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Digital Construction Manager
description:
Digital Construction Manager - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.


Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.


What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Educational Technology Specialist
description:
JOB MISSION:

Provide essential support to educators, and students through faculty, and the IT department in facilitating the effective use of technology for teaching and learning. This includes assisting with the integration of technology into the curriculum, troubleshooting technical issues, and promoting digital literacy among students and faculty to enhance the overall educational experience.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure that classroom technology equipment, such as interactive whiteboards, projectors, and tablets, is properly set up and maintained for instructional use;
  • Collaborate with the IT department to communicate and prioritize technical needs in educational settings, ensuring the seamless functioning of technology resources;
  • Promote digital safety and responsible online behavior among students, guiding them in understanding privacy, cyberbullying prevention, and ethical technology use;
  • Collaborate with educators to integrate technology into lesson plans and curriculum, ensuring that digital tools enhance learning outcomes and align with educational goals;
  • Assist with data entry, management, and analysis related to student performance and digital learning tools, helping educators make data-informed decisions;
  • Ensure that digital resources and technology tools are accessible to all students, including those with disabilities, and provide support in implementing accessibility features;
  • Maintain an inventory of educational technology equipment, track its condition, and coordinate repairs or replacements as needed.


EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology is Required. This person does not need to have a teaching degree as all interactions with students will be through the teacher.


LANGUAGE:

English - Fluent


YEARS OF EXPERIENCE:

Between 3 and 5 years


SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE:

  • Knowledge of K–12 curriculum design, especially IB PYP/MYP/DP frameworks
  • Experience aligning educational technology tools to enhance teaching and learning outcomes
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Workspace for Education Plus
  • Fluency with LMS platforms
  • Proficiency with instructional tools
  • Solid understanding of AI in education
  • Knowledge of coding and robotics platforms used in K–12
  • Experience designing and delivering tech PD
  • Knowledge of adult learning theory and effective faculty onboarding
  • Experience participating in EdTech rollouts, migrations, or pilots

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

title: Traffic Analyst
description:
Position: Traffic Analyst / Analista de OPEC

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - On-site

About SportyNet:

SportyNet, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.

Role Overview:

As a Traffic Analyst at SportyNet, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper scheduling and execution of the channel’s programming and commercial breaks. This role requires precision, coordination, and strong communication across content, operations, and commercial teams to ensure daily broadcast accuracy and efficiency.

Responsibilities:

EN

  • Responsible for reviewing, organizing, and inputting commercial breaks into the playout system.
  • Ensures the correct scheduling of content, promos, and commercials, in accordance with the specifications established in the programming instructions (PIs).
  • Controls all materials scheduled for broadcast, checking their availability, technical quality, and correct naming.
  • Ensures the receipt of CRTs and/or other necessary documentation.
  • Performs last-minute operational adjustments as requested by the Programming Coordination team.
  • In collaboration with the transmission coordinator, ensures the execution of the programming instruction (PI) during live events in the event of failures, delays, or emergency changes.
  • Collects and organizes data related to commercial airings.

Requirements:

  • Fluent in both English/Portuguese, with excellent communication skills.
  • Previous experience in Traffic, Broadcast Scheduling, or Media Operations;
  • Familiarity with playout systems and scheduling tools;
  • High attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work under pressure;
  • Strong communication skills and team-oriented mindset;
  • Basic technical understanding of video formats and broadcast standards;
  • Proficiency in Excel and strong organizational skills for managing materials and reports;

—--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PT- BR

Descrição da Vaga – Como Analista de OPEC

Local: São Paulo (modelo híbrido)

Empresa: SportyNet

Visão Geral da Função:

Como Analista de OPEC, você será responsável por garantir a execução adequada da grade de programação e dos espaços comerciais do canal, assegurando a correta inserção de conteúdos, chamadas e janelas publicitárias. Atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de programação, operações e comercial, o profissional será peça-chave para o controle técnico e operacional das exibições diárias.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pela conferência, organização e inserção de janelas comerciais no sistema de playout.
  • Garante o correto agendamento de conteúdos, chamadas e comerciais, respeitando as definições estabelecidas nas PIs.
  • Realiza o controle de materiais a serem exibidos, conferindo se estão disponíveis, com qualidade técnica e nomeação correta.
  • Garante o recebimento de CRTs e/ou outras documentações necessárias.
  • Realiza ajustes operacionais de última hora sob demanda da Coordenação de Programação.
  • Em conjunto com o coordenador de transmissões, no caso de partidas ao vivo, garanta a execução da PI em caso de falhas, atrasos ou mudanças emergenciais.
  • Coleta e organiza dados de exibições comerciais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em OPEC, programação de TV ou operações de mídia;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de playout e ferramentas de agendamento de mídia;
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso de responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalho sob pressão;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe;
  • Conhecimento técnico básico de formatos e padrões de vídeo;
  • Domínio de Excel e boa organização para controle de materiais e relatórios
  • Ingles avançado / fluente

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”)..
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.
